title: FoodLotProvenanceEntryV1
description: Immutable Holochain entry wrapping producer-side lot declarations and an optional exact predecessor action hash. The integrity callback binds producer_ref to the signing agent and validates the append-only revision chain.

previous_revision_action.description: Serialized Holochain ActionHash of the exact preceding FoodLotProvenanceEntryV1 create action. Null only for revision 1.
